toolsPreview.name: publish
toolsPreview.description: Publish content as a clean, shareable public web page and get back a URL you can give to a human. Use this whenever you produce a report, plan, summary, analysis, doc, or any artifact the user should read or share — instead of dumping a wall of text into chat. Content is Markdown by default.

toolsPreview.name: update_page
toolsPreview.description: Update the title or content of a page you previously published (same URL, new content).

toolsPreview.name: list_pages
toolsPreview.description: List the pages you have published in this space (id, title, URL, view count).

toolsPreview.name: unpublish
toolsPreview.description: Delete a page you published so its URL no longer works.
